WITH scored AS (
  SELECT category, rating, 1 - (emb <=> $1) AS sim
  FROM reviews
),
shifted AS (
  SELECT category, rating, sim,
         max(sim) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS max_sim
  FROM scored
),
weighted AS (
  SELECT category, rating, exp((sim - max_sim) / 0.001) AS w
  FROM shifted
)
SELECT category,
       sum(rating * w) / sum(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM weighted
GROUP BY category;

WITH scored AS (
  SELECT id, category, ts, rating, 1 - (emb <=> $1) AS sim
  FROM reviews
),
weighted AS (
  SELECT id, category, ts, rating,
         exp((sim - 1.0) / 0.02) AS w
  FROM scored
)
SELECT id, category, ts,
       sum(rating * w) OVER win / sum(w) OVER win AS rolling_weighted_avg_rating
FROM weighted
WINDOW win AS (
  PARTITION BY category
  ORDER BY ts, id
  ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY category, ts, id;
```
